segments.text: What if Tanjiro could hear demons' thoughts? The universe added notifications with no mute button available.
segments.label: THE WORST GROUP CHAT

segments.text: This is an invented ability. Understanding suffering might help him protect people.
segments.label: A FAN MADE EXTRA ABILITY

segments.text: Instead, fear and memories arrive together. Welcome to a cursed open-plan office. Terrible acoustics.
segments.label: TOO MUCH INFORMATION

segments.text: Zenitsu asks if it helps, screams. Outstanding. His own emergency broadcast system.
segments.label: ZENITSU WOULD LIKE TO DECLINE

segments.text: A demon thinks it means no harm. Reassuring, except hearing a thought doesn't make it reliable.
segments.label: A DANGEROUS ASSUMPTION

segments.text: Frightened people can hurt others. Confident memories can mislead. Empathy still needs evidence and practical boundaries.
segments.label: EMPATHY NEEDS EVIDENCE

segments.text: Nezuko reminds him why he cares. Someone can deserve compassion without everybody else surrendering their safety.
segments.label: REMEMBER THE PERSON

segments.text: He protects bystanders first, then listens. He installed a firewall on that enormous heart.
segments.label: PROTECT FIRST LISTEN TOO

segments.text: A hidden memory suggests a missing person's location. He checks instead of trusting blindly. The ability helps.
segments.label: USE THE DETAIL

segments.text: Zenitsu asks if Tanjiro can mute him. Different species, brother. Your volume is a local government issue.
segments.label: THE COMPLAINT DEPARTMENT

segments.text: Understanding doesn't promise agreement or painless solutions. The new ability changes his choices, not every consequence outside.
segments.label: NO PERFECT EASY ENDING

segments.text: Tanjiro keeps his kindness and learns restraint. The upgrade wasn't hearing everything. It was knowing when to listen.
segments.label: KEEP THE HEART ADD SETTINGS
